      "evidence": "Modifies core logging infrastructure and startup argument parsing across src/logging.* and src/init/common.*.",

      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Fixes confusing configuration behavior where specifying `-loglevel` without `-debug` silently did nothing, streamlining debug and trace options into a consistent syntax."
